definitionZh: : Any-link CSS 伪类选择器代表着一个元素,它充当超链接的源锚,独立于它是否被访问过. 换句话说,它匹配每个具有href属性的a或区域元素. 因此,它匹配所有匹配:link或:visited的元素.
sourceDefinition: The :any-link CSS pseudo-class selector represents an element that acts as the source anchor of a hyperlink, independent of whether it has been visited. In other words, it matches every a or area element that has an href attribute. Thus, it matches all elements that match :link or :visited.
